data.title: Ethereum ETF outflows and rising exchange inflo... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum saw $70.7 million withdrawn from ETFs, led by BlackRock's $52.8 million outflow, interrupting prior inflows and raising concerns about institutional demand. Concurrently, a $5.92 million net inflow into exchanges indicated more ETH was available for trading, suggesting cautious investor behavior near resistance levels. Price rejection below $1,950 weakened bullish momentum, with $1,800 emerging as the next key support level. Market liquidity clusters suggest volatility ahead, with the next significant price move dependent on which side absorbs liquidity first.
